name: agent-control-deck
description: Local desktop monitor for agent conversations across projects
author: Agent Control Deck contributors

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-local-matching.mjs && node scripts/build-sdk-supervisor.cjs && electron-vite dev
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node scripts/build-local-matching.mjs && electron-vite build && node scripts/build-sdk-supervisor.cjs
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && node scripts/build-renderer-tests.cjs && playwright test
scripts.check: npm run test:commit-guard && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && node scripts/build-native-acceptance.cjs && playwright test --config playwright.electron.config.ts
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run test:electron
scripts.test:acceptance:prepare: npm run build && node scripts/build-native-acceptance.cjs --bounded-sdk && esbuild scripts/embedded-acceptance/run.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out-tests/app-acceptance.mjs
scripts.test:acceptance:wire: npm run test:acceptance:prepare && python3 scripts/with-test-display.py node out-tests/app-acceptance.mjs --synthetic-wire
scripts.repro:embedded:backend-death: npm run test:acceptance:prepare && python3 scripts/with-test-display.py node out-tests/app-acceptance.mjs --synthetic-wire --crash-repro
